text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:
-The weather is reasonably calm today but the heavy snow fall is expected to hit Norway again tomorrow, closing some roads and delaying trains and flights.
-Norwegian companies failed to pay a toal of 14.5 billion crowns in tax last year.

-About 330,000 Norwegians will watch the world nordic skiing championships in Trondheim, which starts this weekend, during work hours. This TV viewing will cost employers 540 million crowns in lost income.
-Some clients, including pension fund Folketrygdefondet, are leaving brokerhouse R.S. Platou following a controversy around the share emission in offshore company NAT last month.
-It is not possible to ban commercial trading over Internet even though user safety is poor.
